meta.title: Konform — EU e-invoicing pre-flight check
meta.description: A WooCommerce store with orders that are not ready to be invoiced. Opens straight on the pre-flight report.
meta.author: ekremtekerek

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; update_option('woocommerce_store_address','12 Rue de Rivoli'); update_option('woocommerce_store_city','Paris'); update_option('woocommerce_store_postcode','75001'); update_option('woocommerce_default_country','FR:IDF'); update_option('woocommerce_currency','EUR'); update_option('konform_seller_vat_number','FR40303265045'); $mk=function($name,$price){ $p=new WC_Product_Simple(); $p->set_name($name); $p->set_regular_price($price); $p->set_virtual(false); $p->save(); return $p; }; $widget=$mk('Ergonomic Desk Lamp','100'); $service=$mk('Annual Support Plan','250'); $service->set_virtual(true); $service->save(); $order=function($product,$fields) { $o=wc_create_order(); $o->add_product($product,1); foreach($fields as $k=>$v){ $s='set_'.$k; if(method_exists($o,$s)){ $o->$s($v); } } $o->calculate_totals(); $o->set_status('completed'); $o->save(); return $o; }; $order($widget,['billing_company'=>'Weber Handel GmbH','billing_first_name'=>'Jonas','billing_last_name'=>'Weber','billing_address_1'=>'Hauptstrasse 5','billing_city'=>'Berlin','billing_postcode'=>'10115','billing_country'=>'DE','billing_email'=>'jonas@example.test']); $ok=$order($widget,['billing_company'=>'Bakker Retail BV','billing_first_name'=>'Sanne','billing_last_name'=>'Bakker','billing_address_1'=>'Keizersgracht 12','billing_city'=>'Amsterdam','billing_postcode'=>'1015 CJ','billing_country'=>'NL','billing_email'=>'sanne@example.test']); $ok->update_meta_data('_billing_vat_number','NL123456789B01'); $ok->save(); $svc=$order($service,['billing_company'=>'Studio Marchetti Srl','billing_first_name'=>'Elena','billing_last_name'=>'Marchetti','billing_address_1'=>'Via Roma 8','billing_city'=>'Milano','billing_postcode'=>'20121','billing_country'=>'IT','billing_email'=>'elena@example.test']); $svc->update_meta_data('_billing_vat_number','IT12345678901'); $svc->save(); $bad=$order($widget,['billing_first_name'=>'Camille','billing_last_name'=>'Durand','billing_address_1'=>'8 Rue Sainte-Catherine','billing_city'=>'Bordeaux','billing_postcode'=>'33000','billing_country'=>'FR','billing_email'=>'camille@example.test']); $bad->set_total('92.50'); $bad->save(); $noname=$order($widget,['billing_email'=>'anon@example.test']); delete_transient('konform_preflight_report'); delete_site_transient('konform_preflight_report');
